CustomObject.description: One record per recognized PII field shape (Email, SSN, Bank Account, etc). Keyword-matching rules used by AIPiiFieldTypeClassifier to derive a field's PII type from its API name, label, or data type - admin-configurable in Setup so new field-name shapes can be added without a deployment. Optionally tagged with a Compliance Group and linked to a Data Masking Rule.
CustomObject.label: AI PII Field Type
